messages.subject: error message and no figure
parts:
Could anyone help me with the ggplot function? When I typed in these
codes:
usa_geom<-fortify(USA,regions="FIPS")
usa_map_df<-merge(usa_geom,USA, by.x="id", by.y="FIPS")
map1<-ggplot(usa_map_df, aes(long,lat,group=group))+
geom_polygon(data=usa_map_df, aes(fill=Bush_pct))+
coord_equal()+
scale_fill_gradient(low="yellow",high="red")+

geom_path(data=usa_geom,aes(long,lat,group=group),lty=3,lwd=0.1,color="white")
map1

It gave the wrong message and there's no figure,
Error in if (nrow(layer_data) == 0) return() : argument is of length
zero

But I don't know how to deal with it.

Thanks for your help.

messages.subject: Re: error message and no figure
parts:
At a guess, one of the data frames involved has zero rows? If you
provide a reproducible example, people will be able to help you.
Without (currently you've given code, but no data), not so much.

Ben
